basis: The owner of the licensed pack cleared the whole library to ship. This is a rights and suitability decision taken over the pack as a whole; it is not a record of anybody having listened to each of the 369 files. Every asset approved this way carries review.approvalSource = "library" so that distinction survives into the app, and the three assets with named entries in organic_audio_overrides.json keep approvalSource = "curator" because a person did check those individually.
